loop.top3_why: The mean of the full pool (A) delivers the most stable per‑window errors (all within ~0.02 of each other) and a reasonably low overall score. The DBA strategy (C) achieves a lower mean score but its per‑window errors are highly variable (0.55–0.73), indicating possible over‑fitting to the few validation windows.
